verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public API (REST, GraphQL or similar) for driving GitLab programmatically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The MCP-agent connection claim and the official CLI belong to other stories and are not credited here. The axis clearly applies to a DevOps platform, so the lack of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
